title: 1994 Midnight CRT & VHS Sanctuary
summary: A Three.js 1990s editing den with six curved CRT monitors, an open VHS cassette deck, magnetic degauss waves, and a Star Cadet cabinet.
description: A Three.js / WebGL2 editing den set at 11:47 PM in 1994. Six curved televisions and broadcast monitors share a walnut desk with a tabletop Star Cadet arcade cabinet, animated VHS tape carriage, magnetic degauss sweep, and CRT phosphor grille post-processing.
